items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: That's where Bill Matthews lived in. He used to live right down in the area.

ctx.x: The only one I know that's still active is, that I know of is Bill Matthews. Oh yeah. He used to play the silver standard. I was listening to him when he practiced, wake out a little bit yesterday. I was around in his neighborhood. Where he live in? Mylon Street.

That's where Bill Matthews lived in. He used to live right down in the area. He moved up though. He bought his home and everything. Yeah, his nice place, that beautiful home. I haven't been up there yet.
You got a wife? Yeah, uh-huh.
